name: Hensel Mi_ST_63 busbar support
summary: Mi_ST_63 busbar support arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: Mi_ST_63 is the drawing identifier for busbar support in Hensel's ENYMOD Mi enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. A busbar support locates the selected conductor arrangement. Its drawing concerns the mechanical interface; electrical spacing and withstand requirements belong to the engineered system design.

For example, in a distribution assembly with a separately selected supported busbar, use the Mi_ST_63 reference to coordinate support fixings, conductor interface and adjacent equipment. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Mi_Sammelschienentraeger/Mi_ST_63.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep support fixings, conductor interface and adjacent equipment visible in the layout.
This reference concerns the named Mi_ST_63 drawing and its busbar support role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
drawingChecklist: Match Mi_ST_63, the native drawing identity and the project equipment schedule.
Match the selected conductor arrangement and manufacturer system design.
Coordinate support fixings, conductor interface and adjacent equipment with neighbouring equipment.
Confirm the current manufacturer installation instructions, selected revision and any required mounting or clearance details.
